description: CS 455 ULS assessment of reinforced concrete beam sections with the plugin's own engine: reads the concurrent force rows (BEAMFORCE / BEAMFORCEVBM for envelopes and moving loads, kN·m; a moving-load case from a model analysed without 'Normal + Concurrent Force' is refused as NOT CONCURRENT) at the chosen element ends for the chosen combinations, and runs every row — N–M flexure by strain-compatibility equilibrium, shear (additive approach, links optional), torsion (cl 5.17–5.27) — or, with member set to a column, pier or pile, the CS 455 Section 7 checks (N_uz, slenderness and additional moments, biaxial bending Eq 7.7.2a, bar restraint 7.6, shear 7.10.1 / Eq 7.11) — with status per row (PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / OUTSIDE RANGE OF VALIDITY) and the utilisation of each check. Read-only. Takes a while for many rows (a job on the website).

axialSign.description: Positive MIDAS axial is tension (-1, default) or compression (1).

cases.description: Load cases / combinations by name (default: every load combination the model has).

concreteModel.description: Figure 3.4.1 curve (default) or the constant 0.6 fcu/γmc block of cl 5.1(3).

concreteParts.description: Composite sections: { part id: f_cu } where a part's grade differs (describe lists the parts).

confirmDimensions.description: Only after the user has compared the drawn section with the drawing: needed when CIVIL NX published no properties to check the outline against.

fcu.description: Concrete cube strength, MPa (default: from the model's EN grade C../.. — its cube value).

image.description: cs455_describe_section only: return the drawing of the section with its bars (default true).

includeJobs.description: Also return the exact engine job of each listed row (for audit or re-running in the plugin).

links.description: Links (omit for concrete-only shear, cl 5.6). Used by shear and by torsion.

maxResults.description: How many rows to list, worst first (default 40).

maxRows.description: Stop above this many force rows (default 1000).

member.description: Assess as a column, pier or pile to CS 455 Section 7 instead of a beam (the plugin's Sections tab > Member). The effective height about each axis is a Table 7.2 case (1: both ends held in position and rotation 0.7; 2: top in position only, bottom fixed 0.85; 3: both ends in position only 1.0; 4: bottom fixed, top unrestrained, racked rollers 1.3; 5: bottom fixed, top unrestrained 1.4; 6: bottom fixed, top restrained in rotation only 1.5; 7: cantilever, top free 2.3) or your own factor k (l_e = k l_o). Give links: their diameter and spacing decide whether the compression bars count (7.6). A pile is assessed as a column with no soil restraint: give k for its depth to fixity. Omit for a beam.

caseY.description: Table 7.2 case about the y axis (bending My); 0 = use kY. Default 3.

caseZ.description: Table 7.2 case about the z axis (bending Mz); 0 = use kZ. Default 3.

kY.description: Effective height factor about y (used when caseY is 0 or omitted with kY given).

momentSign.description: Positive MIDAS My is sagging (1, default) or hogging (-1).

rebar.description: The bar schedule, as the plugin's Reinforcement tab: cover (mm to the bar face, default 50), gap (mm between layers, default max(25, Ø)), rows [{face: bottom|top|side|depth, layer (any whole number, 1 = outermost), count ('8' bars or '@150' spacing), dia (mm, or '1.128in', or '#9'), depth (mm below top, face 'depth' only), span ('±430:900' width limits), from/to/which (side bars)}], coords {datum: bc|bl|tc, text: 'y z dia' per line, mm}.

dia.description: Bar diameter: mm (32, 28.6), inches ('1.128in', '1 1/8"') or a US bar number ('#9').

restrained.description: Compression bars are restrained by links (cl 5.3.1). Default false: compression bars get no compressive strength (cl 5.3.2(1)), conservative.

secondaryActions.description: Vy / T / Mz: assess N–My–Vz and list them (default), or refuse rows where they are non-zero.

sectionId.description: The CIVIL NX section id (a beam section).

stations.description: Element ends to assess (default: the section's first element, both ends, midspan). Location 'support' removes the shear enhancement near supports.

torsion.description: Torsion check, CS 455 cl 5.17–5.27, on rows that carry a torque (default true, as in the plugin).

name: cs455_assess
title: CS 455 assessment of an RC beam, column, pier or pile section
